title: Create auth composables
description:
Build Vue composables for authentication state and actions.

## Files to create:
- app/composables/useAuth.ts - Main auth composable (session, signIn, signOut, signUp)
- app/composables/useAuthProviders.ts - Dynamic provider detection based on runtime config

## Key features:
- Uses createAuthClient from better-auth/vue
- useSession() for SSR-compatible auth state
- Provider list dynamically populated from runtimeConfig flags
- Graceful fallback when auth not configured (returns null session, no errors)

## Usage pattern:
const { session, signIn, signOut } = useAuth()
const { providers } = useAuthProviders()

title: Add protected routes middleware
description:
Implement Nuxt middleware for route protection.

## Files to create:
- app/middleware/auth.ts - Protect routes requiring authentication
- app/middleware/guest.ts - Redirect authenticated users from auth pages

## auth.ts behavior:
- Check session via useAuth()
- If no session, redirect to /login
- Handles loading state gracefully

## guest.ts behavior:
- If user already logged in, redirect to / or /dashboard
- Apply to login/signup/forgot-password pages

## Usage in pages:
definePageMeta({ middleware: 'auth' })  // requires login
definePageMeta({ middleware: 'guest' }) // logged-in users redirected

title: Install Better Auth
description:
Install Better Auth library for authentication.

## Dependencies to add:
- better-auth (core library)
- @convex-dev/better-auth (Convex adapter)
- zod (form validation for UAuthForm)

## Context:
Better Auth is a TypeScript-first auth framework. Uses proxy architecture where Nuxt proxies /api/auth/* to Convex HTTP endpoints. The @convex-dev/better-auth adapter manages users, sessions, accounts tables automatically in Convex.

title: Build login/signup pages
description:
Create login and signup pages using NuxtUI components.

## Files to create:
- app/pages/login.vue - Login with email/password + social providers
- app/pages/signup.vue - Registration with validation
- app/pages/forgot-password.vue - Password reset request

## Components used:
- UAuthForm - Built-in auth form with providers, fields, validation
- UPageCard - Card wrapper for centered auth forms
- UAlert - Error display in validation slot
- ULink - Navigation between auth pages

## Features:
- Zod schema validation for email/password
- Dynamic provider buttons (only shows configured OAuth)
- Links: login <-> signup <-> forgot-password
- Error handling via UAuthForm validation slot

title: Configure auth providers
description:
Set up authentication providers with graceful degradation.

## Files to create:
- convex/convex.config.ts - Register Better Auth component
- convex/auth.ts - Auth instance with conditional providers
- convex/http.ts - HTTP router for /api/auth/* endpoints
- server/api/auth/[...all].ts - Nitro proxy to Convex

## Environment variables:
- BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (required, 32+ chars)
- GITHUB_CLIENT_ID / GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET (optional)
- GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET (optional)

## Graceful handling:
Only add providers to config if credentials exist. If no OAuth configured, social buttons won't appear. Email/password always available.
